title: Persistent task coordinate × transient Hebbian state
hypothesis: Separating a persistent task identity scalar from a transient Hebbian associative state will preserve heldout task×memory compositions with lower total payload bytes than storing an independent effective matrix for every pair.
mirror_coordinate: Persistent task gain and transient episode state coordinate
logical_multiplicity: Task identities composed with memory episodes
controls: independent full effective matrices for observed task×episode pairs
native CAVIA-style persistent scalar context times Hebbian fast matrix
Mirror task View times transient fast-state View

development.selection_metric: heldout compositional nRMSE, actual total bytes, active MAC proxy

success_gate: Heldout unseen-combination nRMSE <= 1e-6 and >=25% total serialized-byte reduction vs independent pair matrices, with zero cross-episode state leakage.
failure_gate: Quality/reset gate missed or <25% byte reduction; exact native factorization alias means no Mirror-specific attribution.
boundaries: Task gains and fast memories are independently sampled factors; pairwise bank trains only on a subset of combinations.
Fresh worlds 37/59 are not used for tuning.

amendments.reason: Post-run independent review found accounting/verification defects: query MACs omitted query count, native/Mirror MACs were asymmetric by formula, fast-state byte dtype was misreported, reset did not reuse the same writable object, and serialization roundtrip was asserted without reload.
changes: Count all 16 query vectors per heldout pair; count task gain multiply for native and Mirror equally.
Generate teacher memory matrices in float32; report one writable state and full state bank separately.
Reuse the same fast-state array across episodes and clear it in place before the next episode.
Reload serialized NPZ and compare each tensor byte-exactly.
amendments.fresh_policy: Seeds 17, 37, 59 were deterministically replayed only to correct accounting/verification; no hyperparameters or model selection changed. Initial exposed fresh metrics are superseded by this amendment.
